name: restApiLoopbackRestricted
definition: The management interface permitted-IP list names specific sources and does not include an any-source or very wide entry. An empty list means any source is allowed (False).
population: the management interface permitted-IP list of the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The management permitted-IP list showing at least one entry and no any-source or very wide entry.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: deviceconfig/system/permitted-ip/entry (the MGT permitted IP list) from the CLI hierarchy. A successful reply with no entries reads as any source allowed (False). An IPv4 prefix shorter than /8 (IPv6 shorter than /16) counts as open; other wide unions of ranges are not detected. Interface management profiles on data-plane interfaces are not read.
